summary: Operator catalogue page. FilterDropdown is an accessible listbox (role button/listbox/option, Enter/Space toggle, Escape closes, click-outside closes via module44705.W) with an 'all' option plus options for type 'prof' (guard, caster, support, shielder, vanguard, assault) or 'elem' (fire, ice, electric, nature, physic); labels come from operator.filter.<type> and operator.<type>.<key>, and the icon div is keyed so it re-mounts on change. OperatorCard shows portrait, name, '// codename', zero-padded index / total, and prof/elem icons; a layout effect fits the name into 11.1875rem by bisecting the font size 28 times between 0.5625rem and 1.6875rem using canvas measureText with font '"SansBold", sans-serif', re-running after document.fonts.ready/load and on ResizeObserver. OperatorListSection keeps isDetailMode/detailIndex, prof and elem filters, filters I18n operators (gL), and swaps between the list (background deco with hollow 'ENDFIELD' text, dropdowns, a vertical scroll container) and OperatorSection in detailMode inside AnimatePresence mode 'wait' with 0.3s easeOut opacity fades.
